bagPolicy.summary: Life Is Beautiful is not scheduled for 2026, so there is no current bag policy.
bagPolicy.note: The official site still shows the 2021 edition and lists no newer dates. Last published rule (2021): bags up to 6" x 8" x 3" did not need to be clear; larger bags and backpacks had to be clear plastic, vinyl or PVC.

parking.note: No current festival site or parking plan is published. Historical resale parking listings are not official transportation guidance.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Life Is Beautiful's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Life is Beautiful 2023 offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including a curated Pizzeria with rotating menus from top pizzaiolos and an Omakase Cantina featuring high-concept dinners. Attendees can enjoy offerings from popular Las Vegas restaurants and vendors throughout the festival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Every stage has a raised accessible viewing platform for people who use mobility devices, with folding chairs and access staff at each one. Service animals must stay under the handler's control and supervision.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: VIP ticket holders can re-enter the festival. General admission has no re-entry.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Life Is Beautiful. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Festival entrances are at Fremont and 7th Street and at Fremont and 11th Street. Gate times are set for each edition, so check the festival's current schedule.
